personal.name: Mohamad Tarabishi
personal.title: Senior Mobile Engineer
personal.shortBio: Senior iOS / Mobile Engineer with 7+ years of experience shipping clean, production-grade apps for 1M+ users across e-commerce, food delivery, fintech, real estate, and fitness verticals. Champion of clean architecture, SOLID principles, and CI/CD automation. Led teams of 5+ to deliver 10+ projects generating $2M+ in revenue.
